article.title: Muscat, Oman travel notes
article.excerpt: Oman feels more relaxed than much of the Middle East or Gulf, and vistas in Muscat can include the sea, white alabaster buildings, mountains in the backdrop, and some older castles.There are plenty of foreigners around, but unlike in much of the Gulf most of the people you see are natives not migrants.
